IGNTU Nursing Tutor Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for IGNTU Nursing Tutor Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for IGNTU Nursing Tutor Recruitment?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the IGNTU Nursing Tutor position is scheduled for 25th September 2026. Candidates should ensure they reach the venue on time with all necessary documents.

faq.question: Q2. What are the educational qualifications required for the Nursing Tutor post?
faq.answer: Candidates should possess M.Sc. Nursing from a recognized institution. Alternatively, B.Sc. Nursing or Post Basic B.Sc. (Nursing) with at least one year of professional experience is also accepted.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Nursing Tutor position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Nursing Tutor post is 40 years. Age relaxation will be provided to SC/ST/OBC/PWD candidates as per government rules.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Nursing Tutor role?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Nursing Tutor position will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 25,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the IGNTU Nursing Tutor recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection of candidates for the Nursing Tutor post will be based on a Walk-in Interview conducted by Indira Gandhi National Tribal University.

faq.question: Q7. Where is the walk-in interview going to be held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at Indira Gandhi National Tribal University, Amarkantak, Madhya Pradesh. The exact venue details will be available in the official notification.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, category certificates (if applicable), and passport-size photographs. Self-attested photocopies of all these documents are also required.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent or contractual job?
faq.answer: The Nursing Tutor position is a contractual job. The duration of the contract will be specified in the official notification.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification can be downloaded from the Indira Gandhi National Tribal University's official website, the link for which is provided in the "Important Links" section of this article.
